title: 中国收入只占一成？：英伟达账本藏了边境芯片，疑似走私量也算进去
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Yeah, Farago, of New Street Research, maintaining a buy rating on the stock with a price tag at a 450, writing the sale of strengthens the case to buy.
segments.zh: 是的，New Street Research 的 Farago 维持该股买入评级，目标价 450，并写道出售增强了买入理由。

segments.en: Jensen's resignation is a material blow. We don't see it affecting near-term earnings.
segments.zh: Jensen 的辞职是一个重大打击。我们认为这不会影响近期盈利。

segments.en: Pietro, I'm just now for more. Piet, good morning. There's one number that jumps off the page for me from your latest report.
segments.zh: Pietro，我现在想了解更多。Piet，早上好。你最新报告里有一个数字让我眼前一亮。

segments.en: China represents only about 10% of revenue directly and indirectly.
segments.zh: 中国直接和间接仅占收入约 10%。

segments.en: How'd you come up with that number? Well, it's directly what's a company report.
segments.zh: 你是怎么得出这个数字的？嗯，直接部分来自公司报告。

segments.en: And indirectly, you know that about 75% of NVIDIA's revenues stay in very easy markets to control mostly the US.
segments.zh: 间接来看，你知道 NVIDIA 约 75% 的收入留在非常容易控制的市场，主要是美国。

segments.en: And then in this number of, we've really looked at physically, chips going physically into China.
segments.zh: 在这个数字中，我们实际考察了芯片物理进入中国的情况。

segments.en: And so we looked at volumes that were nearby the border and big enough and like, values, you know, estimates and reports of incidents and suspicion
segments.zh: 因此我们查看了边境附近的数量和规模，以及估值、事件报告和走私嫌疑。

segments.en: of smuggling and came with this, like, higher value.
segments.zh: 并得出了这个更高的数值。

segments.en: Do you just assume that NVIDIA, all of the revenue out of Singapore is just kind of China?
segments.zh: 你是否假设 NVIDIA 来自新加坡的所有收入都算作中国？

segments.en: No, no, no. I think it was interesting to see very highly ranked official in the administration, making that mistake.
segments.zh: 不，不，不。我觉得有意思的是，政府里一位级别很高的官员犯了那个错误。

segments.en: What gets, like, billed in Singapore, 99% doesn't ever touch the Singapore ground
segments.zh: 那些在新加坡被开票计入的，99%根本不会落到新加坡的地面上

segments.en: and he's actually shipped elsewhere in the world
segments.zh: 实际上却被运到了世界其他地方
